title: This robot rapper has 9m followers on TikTok. The company that created him thinks traditional A&R is 'inefficient and unreliable' (Music Business Worldwide)
notes: MBW, Murray Stassen, 2021-04-01. FN Meka created by Factory New (virtual record label). Co-founder Anthony Martini (also CEO Royalty Exchange); partner Brandon Le. FN Meka voiced by human, music AI-based. No Factory New VC disclosed. Supports Q3 + Q2 negative.
